Targeting opportunities in Capital Markets / Fund Accounting / Reconciliation / Portfolio Operations, to leverage experience in derivatives reconciliation, audit support, and process efficiency to contribute to accurate financial operations and risk control.
Results-driven professional with 14.2 years of experience in Investment Banking & Capital Markets, specializing in reconciliations, derivatives operations, fund accounting, & middle-office functions across EMEA regions.
Expertise in overseeing global reconciliation activities, driving process enhancements, and improving operational efficiency through strong control frameworks, technology enablement, and effective management of fund accounting, income processing, and collateral reconciliation

Led NAV governance and valuation frameworks, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and compliance across complex fund structures
Drove automation and transformation programs to minimize manual intervention and enhance control over high-volume reconciliations
Steered portfolio operations strategy, ensuring seamless trade lifecycle management and alignment with investment objectives

Leading derivatives reconciliation (swaps & options) across multiple client portfolios, performing daily cash, asset, & position reconciliations using Calypso, Enfusion to ensure data accuracy & integrity.
